schema.text: Do you have a disability, health condition or limitation, even a mild one, that makes getting around harder?
schema.help: This question is about you, not people you help. Examples: walking, sight, hearing, attention, pain or mobility aids.

en.#Do you have a disability, health condit: Do you have a disability, health condition or limitation, even a mild one, that makes getting around harder?
en.#This question is about you, not people: This question is about you, not people you help. Examples: walking, sight, hearing, attention, pain or mobility aids.

it.#Do you have a disability, health condit: Hai una disabilità, una condizione di salute o una limitazione, anche lieve, che rende più difficili i tuoi spostamenti?
it.#This question is about you, not people: La domanda riguarda te, non le persone che aiuti. Esempi: cammino, vista, udito, attenzione, dolore o ausili per muoversi.

fr.#Do you have a disability, health condit: Avez-vous un handicap, un problème de santé ou une limitation, même légère, qui rend vos déplacements plus difficiles ?
fr.#This question is about you, not people: Cette question vous concerne, pas les personnes que vous aidez. Exemples : marche, vue, audition, attention, douleur ou aides à la mobilité.

de.#Do you have a disability, health condit: Haben Sie eine Behinderung, eine gesundheitliche Beeinträchtigung oder Einschränkung, auch eine leichte, die Ihnen das Unterwegssein erschwert?
de.#This question is about you, not people: Diese Frage betrifft Sie selbst, nicht Personen, denen Sie helfen. Beispiele: Gehen, Sehen, Hören, Aufmerksamkeit, Schmerzen oder Mobilitätshilfen.

tr.#Do you have a disability, health condit: Hareket etmenizi zorlaştıran, hafif de olsa bir engeliniz, sağlık sorununuz veya kısıtlılığınız var mı?
tr.#This question is about you, not people: Bu soru sizinle ilgili, yardım ettiğiniz kişilerle değil. Örnekler: yürüme, görme, işitme, dikkat, ağrı veya hareket etmeye yardımcı araçlar.

fa.#Do you have a disability, health condit: آیا معلولیت، مشکل سلامتی یا محدودیتی، حتی خفیف، دارید که جابه‌جایی را برایتان دشوارتر می‌کند؟
fa.#This question is about you, not people: این سؤال درباره خود شماست، نه افرادی که به آن‌ها کمک می‌کنید. نمونه‌ها: راه رفتن، دیدن، شنیدن، توجه، درد یا وسایل کمکی برای جابه‌جایی.

hu.#Do you have a disability, health condit: Van olyan, akár enyhe fogyatékossága, egészségi állapota vagy korlátozottsága, amely megnehezíti a közlekedését?
hu.#This question is about you, not people: A kérdés Önre vonatkozik, nem azokra, akiknek segít. Példák: járás, látás, hallás, figyelem, fájdalom vagy közlekedést segítő eszközök.

ar.#Do you have a disability, health condit: هل لديك إعاقة أو حالة صحية أو قيد، ولو كان بسيطًا، يجعل التنقل أكثر صعوبة؟
ar.#This question is about you, not people: هذا السؤال عنك، وليس عن الأشخاص الذين تساعدهم. أمثلة: المشي أو البصر أو السمع أو الانتباه أو الألم أو وسائل المساعدة على التنقل.
